desc:
⭐ Welcome to Hero Power Tycoon! 

This is a combat-based tycoon game inspired by some heroes. Unlock hero powers and build your own tycoon🏗️ to fight⚔️ your enemies. Kill boss and get rewards. Become stronger and richer💸 to be the best on the server! 

PREMIUM PLAYERS GET EXTRA CASH + SPECIAL SKILL! 
GROUP MEMBERS GET EXTRA CASH! 
Lagging? USE A FREE VIP SERVER ❤️ 
This game has AUTO SAVE! Each tycoon is saved separately. 💾 

Share the game with your friends and have fun! 👥
